requirements: Complete each preceding Legion Fealty quest at least once to unlock the next.
Have the required 20 Revenant’s Spellscrolls, 6 Conquest Wreaths and 10 Exalted Crowns.
farmTasks.reward: Completing Legion Fealty 4 awards the Character Page Badge and one additional Exalted Crown. The class is the goal of this questline.
farmTasks.notes: Keep the extra Exalted Crown; it is used to merge Legion Revenant Armor.
